description: 災害防救業務訪評總結報告 [disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 行政院. 行政院每年率中央部會相關辦理地方政府災防業務訪評工作，以全面檢視各項防災整備成效，中央各部會並強化平日督導訪視層面，平時所見將納入聯合訪視之評比結果，以督促各級政府落實整體災害防救工作. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 行政院. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml, json. The portal shows 2026-06-24 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
